solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       MIN(booked_at) AS first_booked,
       MAX(booked_at) AS last_booked
FROM shipments
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Shipments 1 and 2 are booked on 2026-01-31, out of sequence with their neighbours, so they set last_booked for customers 1 and 2. Customers 7 and 8 have no shipments and so do not appear, which the grouping implies.
